By this post and google I learned that both Aristotelian ‘doctrine of the mean’ And the Buddhist ethics of the ‘Middle Way’ are both teleological.

The Buddha was a seeker who once overindulged as a prince and left that life to become a ascetic, beggar and almost starved. He later learned and taught that the ‘Middle Way’ is the right path to healthy living.
